# ADR NUMBER: TITLE

Status: Proposed / Accepted / Superseded

## Context

Describe concrete consumer requirements, constraints, and existing behavior.

## Decision

State the selected boundary/contract, its owner, applicable stable SDK rule IDs,
and any reviewed exception. Distinguish agreed behavior from open details.

## Alternatives and rationale

Explain the realistic alternatives and why the selected approach fits the actual
consumers. Avoid hypothetical frameworks or unmeasured performance promises.

## Consequences and verification

Describe compatibility, ownership, licensing, documentation, and validation impact.
Name evidence needed, delivery boundaries, and reconsideration conditions.

Template guidance: [documentation authority](../README.md).
